messages:
Maria H: Quick q — I'm about to debug a kernel panic on prod db-15. Runbook says to use minimal privileges; what should I request? Need to attach logs and maybe run lsof+gdb for a short window.
Alex P: Minimal access = readonly + ephemeral shell. Request 'prod-readonly-shell' for 1h. No sudo. If you need sudo/gdb, escalate to 2-person approval (Dev + SRE). Keep outputs redacted. :thumbsup:
DevSecOps Claire: +1. Steps I use:
- Create ticket with intent + repro steps
- Request JIT role via IDP (choose 'prod-readonly-shell', duration 1h)
- If you need elevated, mention exact command and duration in ticket so approvers can scope it.
Example request command:
```
vault access request --role=prod-readonly-shell --duration=1h --ticket=INC-2026
```
Sudo example (only after approval):
```
vault access request --role=prod-elevated --duration=15m --scope="/usr/bin/gdb" --ticket=INC-2026
```
SRE Tony: Important: never paste raw logs with PII into Slack. Use the redaction tool before attaching.
Example redaction regex we apply in CI:
```
# mask card/ssn-like sequences
sed -E 's/([0-9]{12,16})/[REDACTED_CARD]/g; s/([0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4})/[REDACTED_SSN]/g' input.log > input.redacted.log
```
DevSecOps Claire: We also have an internal helper 'rdr' for common patterns:
```
rdr --policy=strip-pii /tmp/syslog > /tmp/syslog.redacted
```
oncall-bot: Access request INC-2026: prod-readonly-shell granted to Maria H until 1818008300 (1 hour). :white_check_mark:
Maria H: Thanks — I'll run lsof+gdb under the readonly shell and only request prod-elevated if I can justify the exact gdb steps. I'll upload redacted logs to INC-2026, not here.
Alex P: One more note — don't run `cat /var/log/auth.log` into the ticket. Use `journalctl -u service --since '5m' --no-pager` then redact. Also scrub any IPs tied to customer data.
SRE Tony: If you need to capture core, follow runbook core-collection steps (write to /protected/tmp, compress, run rdr) and attach hash+location in ticket; don't share blobs on Slack.
Maria H: Got it. Will follow the flow and ping here only for approval fast-tracking if needed. :lock:
